claims.statement: Push subscriptions are stored in push_subscriptions keyed by (user_id, endpoint) with a uniqueIndex; device_type is web (default), android, or ios, and the repository contract is Create/GetByUserID/DeleteByEndpoint/DeleteByUserID.

PushService wraps the repository and VAPID config (config.NotificationConfig), using github.com/SherClockHolmes/webpush-go, and exposes Subscribe, Unsubscribe, and SendToUser (fan-out to every subscription for the user).

Notification fan-out runs after the originating transaction commits: domain events are emitted, the handler claims the work, and the notification service assembles the message and pushes via the push service, email publisher, and in-app store.

The PWA service worker (frontend/src/sw.ts) handles browser push events; failed deliveries returning 404/410 from the push service are removed via DeleteByEndpoint so the subscription table stays healthy.
Push is best-effort: payroll confirmations and FlexPay settlement always also write an in-app notification so the user sees the message next time they open the app.
